title: '[FEAT] '

**Feature Summary**
A clear and concise description of the proposed capability.

**Business & User Value**
Which portal or user group does this benefit?
- [ ] Public Web Portal (Property Discovery & Virtual Tours)
- [ ] Customer Dashboard (Purchases, Title Vault, Tracking)
- [ ] Agent / Broker Portal (Leads & Inspections)
- [ ] Admin Operations (Approvals, Analytics, Configuration)

**Technical Architectural Scope**
Which layers are involved?
- [ ] Domain (New entities, value objects, domain events)
- [ ] Application (MediatR commands/queries, validations)
- [ ] Infrastructure (External APIs, Redis, Database migrations)
- [ ] WebApi (REST routes, Swagger definitions)

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Given ..., When ..., Then ...
